extracted.name: Chimichurri sauce
extracted.description: Try our easy chimichurri recipe. This classic South American herb sauce balances a rich steak perfectly, but it works with lots of other grilled foods, too
ingredient_lines: small bunch of coriander finely chopped
small bunch of flat-leaf parsley chopped
1 green chilli (or red chilli), deseeded and finely chopped
2 tbsp red wine vinegar (or white, if you prefer)
instruction_lines: Put the chopped herbs, garlic, onion and chilli in a bowl.
Stir in the oil and vinegar along with a pinch of salt.
